description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) metric. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S.)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  There are five lines displayed: a black dashed line representing “DPR w/o query” which begins at approximately 35.7 at x=1 and ends at approximately 35.6 at x=10, showing a relatively steady trend; a yellow solid line representing “DPR w/ gold” which begins at approximately 34.8 at x=1 and ends at approximately 36.2 at x=10, showing an overall increasing trend; a red solid line representing “DPR w/ bottom-1” which begins at approximately 35.3 at x=1 and ends at approximately 35.6 at x=10, showing a relatively steady trend; a blue dashed line representing “DPR w/ random” which begins at approximately 35.2 at x=1 and ends at approximately 35.3 at x=10, showing a relatively steady trend; and an orange solid line representing “DPR w/ curriculum” which begins at approximately 33.2 at x=1 and ends at approximately 36.5 at x=10, showing an overall increasing trend.
